name: Bentley Education (free civil engineering software)
summary: Free access to Bentley's civil engineering, CAD and infrastructure software for students and educators.
key: Free access to Bentley civil engineering software for students and educators.
how: Sign up for a Bentley Education User Account, then download software from your profile.
catches: Access expires and must be renewed; check your Bentley Education profile for the date.

evidence.quote: Bentley Education gives students and educators free access to industry-leading civil engineering
